cs.t: That’s an apples to oranges comparison (comparing a desktop PC with devices). Desktops last forever. You should be comparing to a 10 year old Dell laptop running latest Windows or a Samsung Galaxy S3 running the latest android. Windows PCs tend to slow down. I had a Dell 530s that I used for 10 years but midway Windows got too slow. I switched to Linux and it extended its life for another 5 years. It’s still quite usable under Linux but I moved on. Apple devices are guaranteed 7 years of support. That’s not bad.
cs.th: Apple Users Are Keeping Their Devices for Longer as Upgrades Slow
